label: Dei Filius 'vivus' at the spine's root from pure act through LIVING_2 and a restricted sense bridge
summary: Stage two of the modal spine, the Dei Filius living conjunct (follow-up to attempt b93ce632, PR #1474). Before: the root endpoint NecessaryDeiFiliusGodRootAt (c0f4a346) got its LIVING_1 conjunct (timeless primitive Primitives.Lives) only through the open bridge 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 is LIVING_1' (8d2ac441). Done (specs/dei-filius-living-self-operation.toml, TruthCore/Causality/DeiFiliusLivingSelfOperation.lean, zero axioms): deiFiliusRootLivingFromPureAct, a second verified route to c0f4a346 that composes the registered deiFiliusRoot without its living bridge (applied to primitives whose Lives is HasIntellect, so that bridge holds trivially and nothing about the real Lives is used) and takes the root's pure act from its immutable conjunct (IsImmutable InPotency has the body PureAct InPotency). The existing STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES (derived in result PURE-ACT-LIVES-FROM-SELF-OPERATION from PureActOperates, SelfOperatingUnmovedLives and MovedOnlyAsInPotencyReading, all open) gives the root life at some time of the duration frame (LIVING_2); the new open sense bridge ad49ea00 'Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and is LIVING_2 is LIVING_1' gives LIVING_1. SENSE HANDLING: LIVING_1 and LIVING_2 (disambiguation 1f2d3b9b) are not identified; the passage is one listed sense_bridges premise, restricted to pure act. Motivation, not derivation: for a pure act a beginning or end of life would be a change, which needs potency (q.9 a.1; STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY), so its life at some time is not a temporary episode; for beings in potency the passage can fail (a being that lived once), which is why the unrestricted LifeAtSomeTimeIsLiving is recorded only for comparison. The frozen DeiFiliusAttributes structure and its Challenges are unchanged; the living conjunct is still LIVING_1, now with a second sufficient condition. CONTROLS (result 2de8c08d, sense_mixing_control): nonvacuity; a pure act that is LIVING_2 and not LIVING_1 (STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES alone does not give the conjunct); the time-indexed premise is needed; the restricted bridge holds where the unrestricted one fails; the new premises hold while the intellect bridge fails (the route does not presuppose it). PREMISE COMPARISON on this route: removes 8d2ac441 (bare); adds ad49ea00 (bare, new) and STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES (already a root-reaching premise of the eternity routes, with one verified derivation from three open premises). So no reduction in open-premise count; the change is that living is tied to the act/potency route (the root's pure act, already derived) rather than to an unanalysed intellect-gives-life step, and the sense passage is explicit. The old route stays registered. OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard): no substantive objection identified to the instances used at the root. One scope point on the universal STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES (target: 'whatever is in potency in no respect operates from itself'; mechanism: an immutable, causally inert being with no potency and no operation, such as an abstract object if the Being domain contains one and InPotency is unactualized ability; justification: the usual platonist characterization of abstracta as causally inert, no source on file). It does not reach the root's instance, whose witness is an actual concrete being; the relevant difference is concreteness, and a concrete-restricted version of the premise would suffice for this route. Unread lead on the other side: Plotinus (the One as source of life rather than living, Enn. VI.7) would target 'the first lives' only through a sense bridge like the one recorded for intellect (DISAMB-PLOTINIAN-PRIORITY-UNITY); not read, not an objection. No substantive objection identified to SelfOperatingUnmovedLives or to the new sense bridge. WARRANT AUDIT: no claim states the sense bridge, STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES, PureActOperates or SelfOperatingUnmovedLives; q.18 a.3 (claim 611be1f0) supports the latter three by relations whose notes record the generalization from God to every pure act. MovedOnlyAsInPotencyReading is the Prima Via premise with its own record. Unread supporting lead: Aristotle, Met. XII.7 1072b26-30 (life belongs to the god, since the actuality of thought is life). No premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: a concrete-restricted STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES if the abstracta scope point becomes the selected question; a typed account of LIVING_1 (operating from oneself without succession) under which the sense bridge could be derived or fail; derive life at every time of the frame from typed Boethian eternity (STMT-IMMUTABLE-IS-BOETHIAN-ETERNAL) and test whether that strengthens the motivation of the bridge; read Plotinus Enn. VI.7 and Met. XII.7 only if the warrant of 'the first lives' becomes the selected question.
